items.title: Discover Yourself, Build Relationships, and Navigate Groups Specialization
items.description: The specialization offered by American Psychological Association on Coursera, provided a comprehensive understanding of human behavior, relationships, and group dynamics. The program explored key psychological concepts such as self-awareness, self-esteem, and self-regulation, along with the factors that influence attraction, relationship formation, and interpersonal communication. It also examined how group environments shape individual thoughts, emotions, and behaviors, including phenomena like group decision-making and social influence. Through a combination of theory and practical applications, the specialization strengthened my ability to build meaningful relationships, navigate team dynamics effectively, and develop a deeper understanding of both individual and collective behavior in professional and social settings.

items.title: Introduction to Tech Entrepreneurship
items.description: This course, offered by IIT Bombay on Coursera, provided a strong foundation in the principles of building and scaling technology-driven ventures. It explored how to identify and evaluate real-world problems as business opportunities, develop innovative solutions, and translate ideas into viable products. The course emphasized key entrepreneurial concepts such as customer discovery, value proposition design, business model development, and go-to-market strategies. Through a structured, beginner-friendly approach, it also introduced the mindset required to navigate uncertainty, think creatively, and leverage technology to create impactful and scalable startups.

items.title: Deep Learning Specialization
items.description: This specialization, offered by DeepLearning.AI on Coursera, taught by Andrew Ng, provided a comprehensive introduction to modern deep learning techniques and their real-world applications. The program covered core concepts such as neural networks, forward and backward propagation, optimization algorithms, and regularization, along with advanced topics including convolutional neural networks (CNNs), sequence models, and natural language processing. It emphasized both theoretical understanding and hands-on implementation using frameworks like TensorFlow, enabling the development of scalable AI solutions. Through practical assignments and projects, the specialization strengthened my ability to design, train, and evaluate deep learning models, while also building an intuitive understanding of how to apply AI to solve complex problems.

items.title: Machine Learning Specialization
items.description: This specialization, offered by Stanford University on Coursera, taught by Andrew Ng, provided a solid foundation in core machine learning concepts and practical model development. The program covered supervised and unsupervised learning techniques, including regression, classification, clustering, and recommender systems, along with key topics such as model evaluation, bias-variance tradeoff, and feature engineering. It emphasized building intuition behind algorithms while also applying them through hands-on coding exercises using Python. Through this specialization, I developed the ability to select appropriate models, train and optimize them effectively, and apply machine learning techniques to solve real-world problems in a structured and data-driven way.
